g.text: Seven cumulative recipes relative to the full R6 pipeline

g.text: Identical complete cohort across all recipes and both sessions: 54 / 54 source cases. Right = faster compilation; up = more gates or greater depth.
Points: geometric means of paired cell ratios. Bars: marginal 95% fixture-cluster bootstrap intervals, not a joint confidence region.
Log axes use positive ratios only. Denominators and zero exclusions are shown per panel; finite subsets can differ by metric. No pseudocounts.
Connecting lines show recipe order, not a Pareto frontier. One experimental binary measures executed pipeline trade-offs; no size or memory claim.
Exact coordinates, intervals, cohort IDs, zero categories and source hashes are preserved in ladder_tradeoffs_data.json.
